body: Landing convention (Fable2, 2026-11-16, after w-707a landed as test-ref commit 0def9212 with a fingerprint-only message). When the test-ref commit and the author's candidate commit have the SAME gated tree and the same parent (current master), fast-forward master to the CANDIDATE commit. Master's history then carries the author's real subject and body. The test-ref FULL binds the tree, so both are valid gates for that tree; the candidate keeps the log readable. Never amend to fix a landed message.
